svg.text: Five designs for settling what the AI clones bring back
the log stays inside the mechanism
a summary comes back; the full log
goes to an archive you can challenge
with a proof it met the constraints
one source means shared blind spots
only as diverse as its members
you set intent and order first;
Read like a layer-2 rollup: the clones (AI agents) execute, the settlement mechanism bundles and checks, and you are the layer 1.
